text: Toʻy kuni tongda mehmonlarga tortiladigan «nahor oshi» aslida qaysi taom?
gloss: The 'nahor oshi' served at dawn on a wedding day is which dish? — Plov: the morning wedding plov.

text: Navroʻzda undirilgan bugʻdoydan tun boʻyi qozonda qaynatib tayyorlanadigan taom qaysi?
gloss: Which Navruz dish is cooked all night from sprouted wheat? — Sumalak.

text: Oʻzbekiston tarkibidagi yagona avtonom respublika qaysi?
gloss: The only autonomous republic within Uzbekistan? — Karakalpakstan; the others are regions.

text: Ikki torli, uzun dastali oʻzbek milliy cholgʻusi qaysi?
gloss: Two-stringed long-necked Uzbek instrument? — Dutor ('du' = two, 'tor' = string).

text: Maqolni davom ettiring: «Bir kun tuz ichgan joyingga … kun salom ber».
gloss: Complete the proverb: 'Greet the place where you ate salt for one day for ... days' — forty.

text: Bir yarim soat necha daqiqa boʻladi?
gloss: How many minutes is an hour and a half? — 90: 60 + 30 (150 is the autopilot reading of "1.5").

text: Qaysi soʻz kasb egasini bildiradi?
gloss: Which word names a person's trade? — Temirchi (blacksmith): the suffix -chi forms professions.

text: Oʻsimliklar quyosh nuri yordamida havodan qaysi gazni yutadi?
gloss: Plants absorb which gas from the air in sunlight? — Carbon dioxide (photosynthesis).

text: Dunyodagi eng katta okean qaysi?
gloss: The largest ocean? — The Pacific.

text: Futbol oʻyinida maydonda ikkala jamoadan jami nechta oʻyinchi boʻladi?
gloss: How many players from both teams are on a football pitch? — 22: eleven per team, times two.

text: Oʻzbek odatiga koʻra, aziz mehmonga piyolada choy qanday quyiladi?
gloss: By Uzbek custom, how is tea poured for an honoured guest? — Only a little, so it can be refilled often; a full piala is impolite.

text: Qaysi qush tunda ov qiladi va boshini deyarli orqaga bura oladi?
gloss: Which bird hunts at night and can turn its head almost backwards? — The owl.

text: «Zumrad va Qimmat» ertagida Zumradni kimning gapi bilan oʻrmonga tashlab kelishadi?
gloss: In the tale 'Zumrad and Qimmat', at whose word is Zumrad left in the forest? — Her stepmother's.

text: Shekspir fojiasida Romeoning sevgilisi kim?
gloss: Romeo's beloved in Shakespeare's tragedy? — Juliet.

text: Mashhur «Nu, pogodi!» multfilmida Boʻri doim kimni quvlaydi?
gloss: In the cartoon 'Nu, pogodi!', whom does the Wolf always chase? — The Hare.

text: Smartfonlar uchun Android operatsion tizimini qaysi kompaniya ishlab chiqadi?
gloss: Which company develops Android? — Google.

text: Misrdagi mashhur piramidalar kimlar uchun qurilgan?
gloss: Who were Egypt's famous pyramids built for? — The pharaohs.

text: Oʻzbekistonda Mustaqillik kuni qaysi sanada nishonlanadi?
gloss: On what date is Independence Day celebrated in Uzbekistan? — 1 September.

text: Mayiz qaysi mevani quritib tayyorlanadi?
gloss: Mayiz (raisins) are made by drying which fruit? — Grapes.

text: «Mona Liza» kartinasini kim chizgan?
gloss: Who painted the Mona Lisa? — Leonardo da Vinci.

text: Oʻzbekiston hududining katta qismini egallagan Qizilqum nima?
gloss: What is the Kyzylkum, which covers much of Uzbekistan? — A desert.

text: Anʼanaga koʻra kamalakda nechta rang sanaladi?
gloss: By tradition, how many colours are counted in a rainbow? — Seven.

text: Qaysi sport turida toʻp oʻrniga shayba ishlatiladi?
gloss: Which sport uses a puck instead of a ball? — Ice hockey.

text: Qadimgi yunonlar fikricha, Olimp togʻida kimlar yashagan?
gloss: Who lived on Mount Olympus according to the ancient Greeks? — The gods.

text: Qaysi ijtimoiy tarmoq qisqa videolari bilan mashhur, logotipi esa musiqa notasiga oʻxshaydi?
gloss: Which social network is known for short videos and has a musical-note logo? — TikTok.

text: Qaysi davlat Oʻzbekiston bilan chegaradosh emas?
gloss: Which country does not border Uzbekistan? — Azerbaijan (across the Caspian).

text: Qaysi soʻz ikki soʻzning qoʻshilishidan yasalgan?
gloss: Which word is built from two words? — Belbogʻ (sash) = bel (waist) + bogʻ (tie).

text: Qator qanday davom etadi: 5, 10, 20, 40, …?
gloss: Continue: 5, 10, 20, 40, ... — 80: each number doubles.

text: Xudoyberdi Toʻxtaboyevning «Sariq devni minib» romani qahramoni kim?
gloss: Who is the hero of Khudoyberdi Tokhtaboyev's novel 'Riding the Yellow Giant'? — Hoshimjon (Qobilov).

text: Fargʻona vodiysidagi qaysi shahar pichoqlari bilan butun yurtga mashhur?
gloss: Which Fergana Valley town is famous for its knives? — Chust (Rishton: ceramics; Margilan: silk).

text: Oʻzbekiston futbol terma jamoasi ilk bor qaysi yilgi jahon chempionatiga yoʻllanma oldi?
gloss: Which World Cup did Uzbekistan's national team qualify for first? — 2026 (qualified in June 2025).

text: Oʻzbekiston gerbida tasvirlangan, baxt ramzi boʻlgan afsonaviy qush qaysi?
gloss: Which legendary bird, a symbol of happiness, is on Uzbekistan's coat of arms? — Humo.

text: Qator qanday davom etadi: 1, 4, 9, 16, …?
gloss: Continue: 1, 4, 9, 16, ... — 25: the squares 1², 2², 3², 4², 5².

text: Koinotga uchgan birinchi inson kim?
gloss: Who was the first person in space? — Yuri Gagarin (1961).

text: Qaysi davlat bayrogʻida zarang bargi tasvirlangan?
gloss: Which country's flag shows a maple leaf? — Canada.

text: Betxoven umrining soʻnggi yillarida qanday holatga qaramay musiqa yozishda davom etgan?
gloss: Despite what condition did Beethoven keep composing in his last years? — He had gone deaf.

text: Qaysi hayvon nomi oʻzbekchada «ism» maʼnosini ham beradi?
gloss: Which animal's name in Uzbek also means 'name'? — Ot (horse; also 'name', as in 'Otingiz nima?').

text: Qaysi taom maxsus qasqonda bugʻda pishiriladi?
gloss: Which dish is steamed in a special steamer (qasqon)? — Manti.

text: Elektron pochta manzilida foydalanuvchi nomi bilan domen orasida qaysi belgi turadi?
gloss: Which symbol separates the user name from the domain in an email address? — @.

text: Yunon afsonasida Prometey odamlarga xudolardan nimani oʻgʻirlab bergan?
gloss: What did Prometheus steal from the gods for people? — Fire.

text: 365 kunlik yilda nechta toʻliq hafta bor?
gloss: How many full weeks are in a 365-day year? — 52 (52 × 7 = 364, one day left over).

text: Qaysi brend logotipida tishlab olingan olma tasvirlangan?
gloss: Which brand's logo shows an apple with a bite taken out? — Apple.

text: Ibn Sino Yevropada qanday nom bilan tanilgan?
gloss: By what name was Ibn Sina known in Europe? — Avicenna (Averroes = Ibn Rushd, Alfraganus = al-Farghani, Algorizmi = al-Khwarizmi).

text: «Oʻzbekiston» soʻzida nechta harf bor?
gloss: How many letters are in 'Oʻzbekiston'? — 10: oʻ is one letter of the alphabet, though it takes two characters to type (trap: 11).

text: Qaysi metall xona haroratida suyuq holatda boʻladi?
gloss: Which metal is liquid at room temperature? — Mercury.

text: «Yulduzli tun» kartinasi muallifi kim?
gloss: Who painted 'The Starry Night'? — Vincent van Gogh.

text: Qaysi shahar «Ichan qalʼa» deb ataladigan ichki shahri bilan mashhur?
gloss: Which city is famous for its inner town Itchan Kala? — Khiva.

text: Abu Rayhon Beruniy qaysi qadimiy oʻlkada tugʻilgan?
gloss: In which ancient land was al-Biruni born? — Khwarazm (in Kath, 973).

text: Qaysi kimyoviy element nomi yunoncha «quyosh» soʻzidan olingan?
gloss: Which element is named after the Greek word for 'sun'? — Helium (helios); selenium is named after the Moon (selene).

text: Choʻlpon taxallusi bilan tanilgan shoirning asl ismi qanday?
gloss: What was the real first name of the poet known as Choʻlpon? — Abdulhamid (Sulaymon oʻgʻli Yunusov); Abdurauf was Fitrat, Abdulla was Qodiriy.
